name: RoadTextVQA roster-information lexical router fresh OCR replay
question: Does replacing the fixed minimum-length assumption with roster-conditioned information evidence recover additional exact destination-name candidates across source-disjoint driving sequences without adding wrong candidates?

development_exposure.observation: The already consumed frame 0 OCR contains exact CAVA, but the frozen legacy minimum length six rule cannot use a four-character credential.
development_exposure.use: Motivated the one structural branch only; video 19 is excluded from evaluation.

selection_state_at_freeze.selection_rule: Thirty manually fixed, one-video-per-row business/place name questions with alphabetic answer aliases, excluding consumed video 19.

official_ocr_archive.content: Ten Google-Vision-style sampled-frame OCR JSON files per selected video at frames 0,30,...,270.

token_contract.normalization: Unicode NFKD ASCII fold, lowercase alphanumeric tokens; source full-text summary is excluded and only individual textAnnotations are used.
token_contract.information_rule: A four- or five-letter alphabetic token contributes two units only when it is exact and appears in exactly one target's aliases in the fixed thirty-target roster. No edit neighbor is permitted for this branch.
token_contract.association: Evidence unions across ten chronologically ordered sampled frames. Emit only when exactly one roster target matches; multiple matches are AMBIGUOUS and no match is UNKNOWN.
token_contract.authority: Search-priority target-name candidate only; no pixel text localization, sign-to-entity association, exact physical identity, facade, portal, entrance, access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, or safety authority.

synthetic_negative_contract.formula: For each fixed row, SHA256(question_id|video|salt), map the first ten hex nibbles to letters a-p, then prefix zz.
synthetic_negative_contract.authority: Generated absent-query canaries only; not human-verified scene target-absence truth.

execution_rule: Run exactly once. Do not change the selected rows, token lengths, evidence weights, edit distance, roster uniqueness, or gate after observing selected OCR.

claim_boundary.allowed: Development evidence for whether roster-unique short exact OCR tokens improve target-name search-priority routing over the frozen legacy length rule on a fresh OCR-unseen RoadTextVQA validation panel.
not_allowed: benchmark-test, blind, independent, provider-controlled, city-disjoint, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, deployment, product, benefit, reliability, or safety confirmation
pixel text localization or a token proving exact physical entity identity, sign ownership, facade ownership, portal ownership, or entrance ownership
public access, traversability, waypoint correctness, arrival, or handoff
